scope: Independent read-only review of shared navigation integration
conclusion: No concrete new blocker found in the reviewed source or the executed handlers.

evidence.checks: Available destinations come from existing catalogue and permission checks; filters only hide allowed cards; no account/grant/database writes. Captured session, generation, current host and busy-state guards protect stale handlers and asynchronous start.

Prevented and modified clicks remain untouched. Mobile menu restores inert state; Escape restores focus; ordinary navigation directs focus to content. Breakpoint change returns focus to toggle if the sidebar disappears.
focusContent selects the visible Fleet frame only while fleet-workspace-active; hidden Fleet falls back to main, hidden main returns false.
Directory controls have visible label/focus, text + underline selected state,44px controls, single column at420px; no new animation or permission affordance bypass.

tests.environment: Node isolated DOM adapter executing actual handlers; no browser

limitations: The DOM adapter does not implement the browser layout engine, native event navigation timing or a real iframe focus stack. Browser, screen-reader and phone rendering remain unverified here.
Full application route guards and native Back behavior were not re-exercised in a browser in this local-only review. No production actions were performed.
